reviewer_role: Separate same-session acceptance/custody reviewer; not external peer review
scope: Read-only manuscript fact-check against frozen production, preserved prior summaries, independently reconciled saved market ledgers and current reproduction interfaces. No research campaign rerun and no experiment-source edits.

reproduction_clarification.severity: Material interpretation/documentation recommendation, no numerical or experiment-source correction
reproduction_clarification.finding: The listed market reproduction command is valid, but the frozen runner has no phase switch and always records runKind FROZEN_MARKET_CONFIRMATION. The same frozen seeds do not add independent evidence. New reproduction files also expand the archive beyond its original all-files manifest.
reproduction_clarification.requested_text: Use a disposable companion copy. Market execution into a fresh directory repeats the registered 1,920 worlds; it is a replay and never an additional primary confirmation despite the preserved runner label. Reproduction timings do not replace the primary values.

limitations: Not visual or typographical PDF review; root owns compiled-page quality.
Same-session assistant independence is narrower than institutional independence.
Shared verifier recomputation is a custody check, not a separate acceptance oracle.
Cost scenarios remain chosen allocations; no missing actual inference or labor charge is identified here.
The technical cohort is six constructed predecessor substitutions, including known development-visible root minima; it cannot estimate market reliability or recurrence.

review_resource_accounting.note: Retain this review in common verification/publication research cost uncertainty; elapsed discussion/tool time is not a measured active-labor charge.
